name: url-intelligence-agent
description: Evidence-first AI URL intelligence agent: deep crawl, entity resolution, social/contact discovery, technology and brand intelligence, SEO/security/trust audits, monitoring, RAG, MCP, API, batch workers and reports.

scripts.benchmark: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js benchmark --raw
scripts.benchmark:hf: npm run build && node scripts/run-hf-benchmark.mjs && python3 hf-dataset/evaluate.py hf-dataset/results/predictions.jsonl --json-out hf-dataset/results/latest.json --markdown-out hf-dataset/results/latest.md
scripts.mcp: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js mcp
scripts.serve: npm run build && node dist/src/cli.js serve

author: Vincenzo Picciuolo / HRN Innovation Technologies Ltd
